texts: good. "each cauldron" becomes a fireable rule with Hesper as the shared agent and "at sundown" carried inside it, and the habitual present correctly gets no tense atom.

mixed: the lifting, the "into" destination and the broad ladle as instrument are all right, but "prewarmed" was fused into a kind symbol (prewarmed_clay_vessel), so the parse invents a kind of vessel instead of saying that these vessels have been warmed. Split the warming into its own clause: "Hesper warms the clay vessels beforehand, and lifts the slick into them with a broad ladle." — "clay vessel" stays the kind, the warming becomes a stated event, and the vessels become definite things the later sentences can refer back to.

mixed: the universal rule is fireable and the mire-essence link is kept, but "a partial vessel of X" puts "partial" on the vessel itself, so the parse says the vessel is incomplete rather than that it is only partly filled. Predicate the level of the contents instead: "Each cauldron yields a vessel that is partly full of mire-essence." — "full of X" is a shape the translator handles directly, with "partly" recorded as its degree.
good. the adjective-restricted bare plural correctly forces a fireable distributing rule with "good" as a premise, and the produced vessel is a separate witness per thread.
good. same shape as the "good threads" sentence — a fireable rule with "poor" as a premise conjunct, and the thin slick as a per-thread witness.
good. the two coordinated verbs are translated independently into two distributing rules over each vessel, each with its own "each" companion.
good. Theme for the carried vessels, Goal for the "to the cellars" path, and a group witness for each definite plural.

good. the shelves become a group with the compound kind unpacked, "arranged" is reified as a state of the collection with the flat atom kept beside it, and "by year" / "by month" are recorded as two sorting-criterion obliques rather than being misread as agents.

mixed: nothing at top level says where the vessels are — both "old" and the position sit in per-member rules keyed to group membership, and those stay dormant until some individual vessel is named, so "where are the old vessels?" currently returns nothing. State the position over the whole set as an event: "The old vessels are stored at the front of the shelves." — that yields a top-level event with the group as its theme and the shelf front as its location, with no keeper asserted.
